plain.li: [company] Mind if I stand here with you for a while?
[company] It's a quiet day here, isn't it?
[company] How long have you lived here?
[company] We've been on the road a while, so it's good to talk to someone new.
[company,their:traders] Business is slow today, so I came over to say hello.
[fire] It's good to sit by a fire after a long walk.
[fire] I'll sit here by the fire for a while.
[fire] We don't often get to sit by a fire like this on the road.
[fire,theirLowtech] At home we sit around the fire every evening.
[warm] My hands are freezing.
[warm] It's cold out, so I need to warm up a bit.
[warm] A few minutes by the fire and I'll be fine.
[seat] My feet hurt, so I'm going to sit down.
[seat] I'll sit here and wait.
[seat] It's nice to sit on a proper seat for a change.
[shelter] I'm getting out of this rain.
[shelter] I'll wait under here until it stops.
[shelter] There's no point standing out there getting soaked.
[snack] Time for a bite to eat.
[snack] I brought some food with me, so I'll have some now.
[snack] Just a little something to keep me going.
[game] Nobody is using this, so I'll have a go.
[game] I haven't played this in a long time.
[game] Let's see if I still remember how to play.
[game,theirLowtech] We play something like this at home.
[watch] Nobody is watching this, so I'll sit here for a while.
[watch] I'll watch for a bit until someone wants it.
[watch,theirLowtech] We don't have anything like this where I come from.
[watch,theirHightech] We have one of these at home too.
[music] I hope nobody minds if I play for a bit.
[music] I haven't played one of these in a long time.
[music] Just a short tune, and then I'll leave it be.
[stars] It's a clear night, so it's a good time to look at the stars.
[stars] I've never looked through one of these before.
[stars,theirHightech] We had one like this back home.
[art] Someone here put a lot of work into this.
[art] That's well made.
[art] I'd like to know who made this.
[pray] I'll say a short prayer here.
[pray] It's good to find a shrine to our god this far from home.
[pray] I always pray before we move on.
[animal] Easy now, let me brush you down.
[animal] You've carried a lot today, haven't you?
[animal] Let me have a look at your feet.
[animal,their:herders] I'll check on the animals while we wait.
[play] I'm going to run around for a bit.
[play] I'm not tired at all.
[play] It's more fun here than on the road.
[drink] I brought my own, so don't worry.
[drink] I'll have a drink before we go on.
[drink] Just one, and then I'll stop.
[smoke] I'll just have a quick smoke.
[smoke] Don't worry, these are my own.
[pipe] Time for a pipe.
[pipe] I always have a pipe after a long walk.
[pipe] I like to smoke a pipe when we stop for a while.
[carve] I carve a little whenever we stop.
[carve] Whittling helps me pass the time.
[carve] I like to keep my hands busy when we stop for a while.
[read] Do you mind if I read this while I wait?
[read] I'll read a few pages and put it back where I found it.
[read] I haven't had a book in my hands for weeks.
[read,their:scholars] We have a copy of this in our archive, but I never got round to it.
[readown] I always carry a book with me for the road.
[readown] I'll read a bit more of my book while we're stopped.
[readown,theirLowtech] I've read this one so often the pages are coming loose.
[walk] I'm going to stretch my legs and have a look round.
[walk] It's a nice day for a walk.
[walk] I'd like to see a bit more of the place while we're here.
[garden] Someone here keeps a good garden.
[garden] I wanted to have a closer look at these flowers.
[grave] I always stop at a grave when I pass one.
[grave] I'll stand here a moment for whoever is buried here.
[grave,their:sextons] Someone should ring for these dead too.
[view] You can see a long way from here.
[view] It's a good spot to stand and look out.
[view] I like to look at the land when we stop somewhere new.
[pet] Hello there, can I give you a scratch?
[pet] You're a friendly one, aren't you?
[pet] Come here and let me pet you.
[pet,young] Can I pet you, please?
[fetch] Go on, fetch it.
[fetch] Here, catch, bring it back.
[fetch] Do you want me to throw it again?
[letter] I promised to write home, so I'd better do it now.
[letter] I'll write a letter while I have a table to sit at.
[letter] My family will want to know where we've got to.
[journal] I'll write down what we've seen today.
[journal] I try to write a little in my journal every day.
[train] I don't want to get out of practice while we travel.
[train] Nobody is using this, so I'll get a little training in.
[train,their:mercenaries] Our captain expects us to train every day, wherever we are.
[spar] I need to keep in practice, even on the road.
[spar] A little sparring keeps me ready.
[archery] I'll shoot a few arrows while the target is free.
[archery] Let's see if I can still hit the middle.
[archery,their:hunters] A hunter who doesn't practise goes hungry.
[fish] I'll see if anything is biting.
[fish] I could do with some fresh fish for the road.
[fish,their:fishers] I can never pass water without putting a line in.
[catch] That's one for the pot.
[catch] Not a bad catch.
[catch] I'll take this one with me.
[mend] This has torn again, so I'd better fix it.
[mend] I'll mend this while I have the time.
[mend] It won't last the road if I don't fix it now.
[sharpen] I'll put an edge back on this.
[sharpen] A blunt blade is no use to anyone.
[bow] The string is wearing thin, so I'll put a new one on.
[bow] A little oil keeps the wood from cracking.
[gun] I'll clean this before the dust gets into it.
[gun] It's been a while since I last cleaned it.
[cards] Do you want a game of cards?
[cards] Sit down, I'll deal.
[cards] One hand, and then we'll see.
[dice] Let's roll the dice and pass the time.
[dice] Do you want a game of dice?
[stones] Do you want to play stones while we wait?
[stones] I'll throw first this time.
[sing] I'll sing something quietly, I hope nobody minds.
[sing] This is a song we sing at home.
[sing,theirLowtech] My mother used to sing this one to us.
[giveway] Go ahead, it's yours, I was only using it while it was free.
[giveway] Sorry, I'll get out of your way.
[giveway] Here, you have it, I'm done.
